title: Test comment asserts an explicit cover `place` watermark that the template hunk says was removed
evidence:
+// (An earlier explicit `place` at the end of the cover block was
+// redundant — it stacked a second 25% layer into a ~44% composite on the
+// cover, mechanically confirmed by background-only / place-only / both
+// variant renders + pixel diff. Do NOT re-add it.)
...
+//    flag differs beyond the metadata noise. The template attaches the
+//    watermark to the page background of every page (plus an explicit
+//    place on the cover, which paints a full-bleed block over the
+//    background), so a present-on-any-page watermark is present on every
+//    page by construction.
detail: Same diff: template hunk says the explicit cover place was removed and must not be re-added; the test hunk asserts it still exists. The test comment describes the pre-fix template and will mislead maintainers.
recommended_fix: Update the audit_report_test comment to match the template: one background layer on all pages, no explicit cover place.

title: Unused `import gleam/bit_array` in ai_integration_test.gleam
evidence:
+import gleam/bit_array
+import gleam/bytes_tree
...
+      let served = case resp.body {
+        wisp.Bytes(tree) -> bytes_tree.to_bit_array(tree)
detail: The added import is never used in the new test; only bytes_tree is referenced. Unused imports emit compiler warnings and may fail warning-strict CI.
recommended_fix: Remove `import gleam/bit_array` from ai_integration_test.gleam, or use it if a call was dropped.

title: Watermark visibility never asserted directly — only marked≠plain byte inequality
evidence:
+      // The watermark layer is real page content: after stripping the
+      // metadata noise the two renders must still differ.
+      should.not_equal(normalize_metadata(marked), normalize_metadata(plain))
detail: Tests only assert marked bytes differ from plain; nothing verifies DEMO text is actually visible on each page. Visibility is only transitively pinned via the committed binaries.
recommended_fix: Add a render or text-extraction check asserting visible DEMO content per page, or document the committed-binary pin as the sole visibility guarantee.

title: Regeneration doc switches to RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR env var; no hunk reads it
evidence:
-////   gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv
-////   (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv" relative
-////    to the server package root.)
+////   RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR=priv gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake
+////   (cwd = server/; RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR is the priv dir. Defaults to "priv"
+////   relative to the server package root.)
detail: Documented regeneration now relies on RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR, but no hunk in the diff reads that variable; main()'s priv_dir binding is not shown changing. Instructions may not match code.
recommended_fix: Confirm main() reads RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR; if it still parses argv, implement the env var or restore accurate instructions.

title: normalize_metadata/typst_available externals and skip logic copied into three test files
detail: The identical @external declaration (plus typst_available and skip_if_no_typst logic) appears in three hunks; policy changes such as the CI panic must now be edited in triplicate.
recommended_fix: Extract the externals and skip helpers into a shared test support module imported by all three files.
